heroTitle.2: Support and Initiative for Rural Development

AboutUs.impact_description: The “Stejarul Dacilor” Local Action Group is an association founded in November 2023, bringing together 14 administrative-territorial units from Cimișlia and Căușeni districts, aiming to promote sustainable rural development by implementing the 2023–2027 Local Development Strategy.
AboutUs.main_headline: LAG “Stejarul Dacilor” is a local association from Cimișlia and Căușeni districts that supports sustainable rural development.

AboutUs.stat_years_activity: Years of activity and rural development.

AboutUs.stat_total_members: Total members from the public, entrepreneurial, and civic sectors.
